title: The Hidden Psychology of Social Media Algorithms

slides.heading: The Hidden Psychology of Social Media Algorithms
slides.body: How platforms engineer your attention — and what you can do about it

slides.heading: What Is an Algorithm?
slides.body: A social media algorithm is an AI system that decides what content you see. It isn't random — it's optimized with one goal: keep you on the platform as long as possible.

slides.heading: The Engagement Trap
slides.body: Algorithms favor content that triggers strong emotions — outrage, fear, awe, and excitement generate more clicks and comments than content that simply informs. Controversy pays.

slides.heading: Variable Reward Loops
slides.body: Like slot machines, social feeds deliver unpredictable rewards. Sometimes a post goes viral; sometimes it disappears. This uncertainty is psychologically addictive — the same mechanism that drives gambling.

slides.heading: The Filter Bubble Effect
slides.body: Algorithms learn your preferences and gradually show you more of the same. Over time, your feed narrows into an echo chamber that reinforces existing beliefs and hides opposing viewpoints.

slides.heading: Dopamine and the Like Button
slides.body: Every like, comment, and share triggers a small dopamine release in your brain. Platforms are deliberately designed to maximize these micro-rewards and keep you chasing social validation.

slides.heading: Time Distortion by Design
slides.body: Infinite scroll and autoplay remove natural stopping cues. Users consistently underestimate how long they've been on their phones — often by 30% or more — because there's no visible end to the feed.

slides.heading: The Attention Economy
slides.body: Your attention is the product being sold. Advertisers pay for eyeballs, so platforms compete to capture as many minutes of your day as possible. Every UX decision is a bid for your time.

slides.heading: Taking Back Control
slides.body: Set daily screen time limits, turn off autoplay, and curate your follows intentionally. Schedule specific windows for social media use — and notice how much calmer your mind becomes.

slides.heading: Be the Algorithm's Boss
slides.body: Understanding how these systems work is the first step to using social media intentionally rather than being used by it. Awareness is the most powerful tool you have.
